hints.text: Orange tiles are cut off from the habitat around them. Teal tiles are well connected. Look for orange along the highway.
Click tiles across the highway to place the crossing. Each tile costs money, and the total is shown at the top. Press Enter to confirm.
Your crossing is built. Animals can now use it to cross the highway safely.
That was a donation. Supporters give money each month, and more connected habitat brings in more.
